The compass is blocked. Allow motion and orientation access for this site in your browser or phone settings, then reload.

The compass reads magnetic north. Auto adds the declination for your position and By hand adds the number you type, so headings are true and line up with markers. Calibrate by moving the phone in a figure-8.

Sight

Some scopes sold as MOA move 1 inch per 100 yd. Check the manual.

Separate marks with spaces or commas, like 1.5 3 4.6.

Type each mark's distance below the centre, from your scope's manual. If the manual gives only yardages, this isn't supported yet.

If the reticle doesn't grow with magnification, the marks are true at one magnification only. The manual says which.

Barrel and bullet (for spin drift)

Bullet length is the bullet alone, from the maker's data or a caliper. For a polymer-tipped bullet the stability figure reads a little low.

Correct from a real shot

Enter a distance and the elevation the rifle really needed there. Uses today's conditions from the Ballistics screen, a level shot and no wind.
